meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把零散素材编排成完整的视频成片或循环动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把品牌素材剪成有节奏的成片或循环画面。
copy.tagline_en: Turn scattered footage into a finished video or looping animation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to edit brand footage into a finished reel or loop.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会编写或修改 HyperFrames 视频合成:多场景短片、品牌片、混剪、静态循环、片头卡、素材重剪等。它先读 BRIEF.md,再规划分镜、装配画面并渲染出成片。
howto.when: 当没有更专门的视频工作流匹配,或 BRIEF.md 里 flow 设为 companion 时接管;全新项目要先走 hyperframes,再回到这个技能。

say.text: 帮我做一个三场景的品牌宣传片,先给我看分镜方案。
say.note: 会先给规划和分镜,再逐场搭建。

say.text: 把这段素材剪成一段混剪,保留原声。
say.note: 会复制视频源并按片段范围重排。

say.text: 这段开头太拖,帮我剪掉前两秒。
say.note: 会做硬切并重排时间轴。

howto.what_en: It lets Claude author or edit a HyperFrames video composition: multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, title cards, footage remixes. It reads BRIEF.md, plans scenes, assembles visuals and renders.
howto.when_en: Takes over when no specialized video workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Fresh creation goes through hyperframes first, then returns here.

say_en.text: Make a three-scene brand reel; show me the storyboard plan first.
say_en.note: Gives a plan and storyboard before building.

say_en.text: Cut this footage into a montage and keep the original audio.
say_en.note: Duplicates the source and sets clip ranges.

say_en.text: The opening drags; trim the first two seconds.
say_en.note: Makes a hard cut and reorders the timeline.
